# GrowthCred

> GrowthCred (Pty) Ltd is a founder-led AI consultancy based in Rosebank, Johannesburg, South Africa. Phila Ngwenya helps owner-led firms put AI to work on real business tasks through private AI, workflow implementation and practical training. Workshops and work outside South Africa are online.

GrowthCred's flagship is the Command Core: the client's own AI on equipment GrowthCred chooses, deploys and maintains, set up around the business's own documents and way of working. The published stages are Velocity (one day, R5M–R50M firms), Integration (90 days, R50M–R200M firms) and Transformation (custom, R200M+ firms). The published guarantee is: “If the Command Core doesn't give you back at least 20% of your week, the engagement is on us.”

GrowthCred does not claim that installing AI alone makes a workflow POPIA-compliant. The information, purpose, access, safeguards, operators, retention and transfer route must be considered for each workflow. Professional judgement and client-facing decisions remain with people.

Company: GrowthCred (Pty) Ltd · CIPC registration 2026/229279/07 · Rosebank, Johannesburg, South Africa.
Founder: Phila Ngwenya, Founder and CEO. Co-developed an AI system presented at Parliament in Cape Town and has given seven AI talks at WeWork Johannesburg.
Contact: info@growthcred.co.za · WhatsApp +27 66 283 0289.

## Services

- [Quote Engine](https://growthcred.co.za/quote-engine): PPE and uniform quotes drafted from your price list. You still approve the price and the send.
- [Company Brain](https://growthcred.co.za/company-brain): your team asks your own files. The answer shows the source.
- [New Hire Trainer](https://growthcred.co.za/new-hire-trainer): one role taught from your notes. It stays inside the business.
- [AI proposal automation](https://growthcred.co.za/ai-proposal-automation).

## Guides

- [How do you send PPE quotes faster without the owner doing every quote?](https://growthcred.co.za/guides/ppe-quotes-without-the-owner): a Quote Engine drafts from your list. You still approve. No supplier is named.

- [I still train every new hire myself. How do I stop?](https://growthcred.co.za/guides/stop-training-every-new-hire): a New Hire Trainer for one role. No time-to-productivity number.
